title: Fix Flow Slider Ghost Double Render
description: flow: The slider has a bug that a second line and knob are pixelated rendered above. Only while dragging the correct slider is visible. Fix so the idle/resting slider shows a single clean line and knob without a pixelated duplicate above.
summary: Fixed the flow graph slider ghost: GPU paint no longer draws track+knob (DOM GraphSliderOverlays owns that chrome), Slider gained showValue={false} for track-only overlays aligned to track bounds, and GraphSliderOverlays uses it. Value readout stays on the GPU to the left of the node. Verified with vitest (UI track-only + graph overlay) and cargo test -p infinite_board_port_directed_dag --lib slider (7 passed).
